title: Rebound to Outlet Full Speed
description: A rebounder secures a shot off the rim, then immediately throws a full-speed outlet pass to start a two-player fast break the other way.

content.objective: Turn a secured rebound directly into the first pass of a fast break without delay.
content.setup: A rebounder stands under the basket; an outlet target sprints up the sideline on the rebound.
instructions: A shot is taken and missed on purpose near the rim.
The rebounder secures with two hands and immediately pivots to find the sprinting outlet.
Deliver a strong, accurate pass ahead of the outlet's path.
The outlet catches in stride and continues toward the far basket.
coachingPoints: Outlet within one or two seconds of securing the rebound — speed matters.
Lead the pass ahead of the sprinting target, not directly at them.
Keep the first pivot quick and away from any defensive pressure.
commonMistakes: Holding the ball too long admiring the rebound before outletting.
Throwing the outlet pass behind the sprinting player.
Releasing the box-out position too early to chase the ball.
content.safety: Make sure the outlet's sprint lane is clear of other groups.
